keyword: has a 1 seed ever lost to 16
claims: A 16-seed has defeated a 1-seed twice in men’s NCAA Tournament history.
No. 16 seeds are 2-158 all-time against No. 1 seeds since 1985.
UMBC (16) defeated Virginia (1) 74-54 in 2018, marking the first time in history a No. 1 seed lost to a No. 16 seed in the opening round.
Before 2018, No. 1 seeds were 0-135 against No. 16 seeds.
No 16-seed has ever advanced past the Round of 32.
